name: 奉仕担当の週間レーン
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH11-0002 奉仕担当の週間レーン. Input 1 is the ORIGINAL Deputy screen; source icon geometry, proportions, optical weight, spacing, alignment and fine controls take priority over the rough mock. Input 2 is our secondary Japanese content/layout guide. Input 3 is the approved bus style reference only; do not copy bus imagery/content.
Recreate the compact weekly team schedule as a wide card on pure white #FFFFFF canvas, at roughly 3x a logical 640x164 layout. A white rounded card with fine neutral border, soft downward shadow, restrained depth. Header: small downward chevron faithful to original, compact forest-green team marker, bold 「受付チーム」 and quiet 「ライトハウス」. Below, three equal aligned date columns: 「18日（日）」, 「19日（月）」, 「20日（火）」. First cell contains 「09:00–12:00」 bold, 「山田 太郎」 regular, 「朝の担当」 metadata. Middle empty cell has only a small slate plus, identical in basic cross geometry to original. Last cell contains 「09:00–12:00」 bold, 「佐藤 花子」 regular, 「朝の担当」 metadata. Preserve all localized information and three-column count. Align day labels horizontally; do not replicate the mock's displaced middle heading. Preserve original subtle scheduling grid alignment.
Scheduled cells should be white, fine neutral outlines, with a slim forest-green selection/accent edge that echoes the original's purple scheduled-state distinction. No broad green fills. Source's orange Manager marker and purple schedule accent are adapted consistently to forest green because this localized component shows one team, not a comparative category legend. Supporting chevron/plus are #526173, no rainbow icons. Do not add Save or new controls; this component has no primary button. No avatars, metrics, app chrome, popup, payroll data or English captions.
Typography remains established Meiryo: body 14/24 regular, metadata 12/16, modest bold header/time, zero tracking; render at proportional scale. Do not enlarge the header into a page title. Source screenshot's central overlay obscures some calendar cells; do not invent hidden source content. Japanese values are the existing saved catalog adaptation. Crisp spacing, text alignment and original fine details outrank rough mock icon substitutions. White surfaces, restrained forest gradient on small team marker if helpful, soft shadows, no plastic shine or mint field fill. Output is a static design candidate.
reviewNotes: 原参照と日本語モックの実画像を確認。原画優先でシェブロン・追加記号・日別境界を統一し、モックの中央日付ずれを修正。三日・二枠の氏名/時間/文言・空枠追加を保持。元の橙役割/紫担当状態は単一チームの森林緑へ。背景白、枠白、アイコンはスレート。原画中央はポップアップで隠れており厳密な参照同等性は不明。画像のみエージェントレビュー済、所有者承認・編集・実装は未実施。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
